verses.sloka: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा ।प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.७५.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāradasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṁ tadā ।praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 7.75.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, having heard those nectar-like words of Narada, Rama obtained immeasurable joy and spoke this to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: वासन्तिको निशा प्राप्ता शीता न च घर्मदा

verses.sloka: गच्छ सौम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठं समाश्वासय सुव्रतम् ।बालस्य तु शरीरं तत्तैलद्रोण्यां निधापय ।। ७.७५.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaccha saumya dvijaśreṣṭhaṁ samāśvāsaya suvratam ।bālasya tu śarīraṁ tattailadroṇyāṁ nidhāpaya ।। 7.75.2 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, go and console that best of Brahmins, the one of good vows, and have the child's body preserved in a trough of oil.

verses.sloka: गन्धैश्च परमोदारैस्तैलैश्चापि सुगन्धिभिः ।यथा न क्षीयते बालस्तथा सौम्य विधीयताम् ।। ७.७५.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: gandhaiśca paramodāraistailaiścāpi sugandhibhiḥ ।yathā na kṣīyate bālastathā saumya vidhīyatām ।। 7.75.3 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, let it be done with very excellent fragrances and fragrant oils so that the child does not waste away.
translations.hindi: ततः सुमन्त्रस्त्वागम्य राघवं वाक्यमत्रवीत । - एते *प्रतिहता राजन्‌ द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति तापसाः ।!३॥ उस समय सुमंत्र ने आ कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा- हे भगवन्‌ [ कुछ तपस्वी लोग द्वार पर ( आपकी अनुमति के लिए) रुके हुए हैं

verses.sloka: यथा शरीरो बालस्य गुप्तः सन् शिष्टकर्मणः ।विपत्तिः परिभेदो वा न भवेच्च तथा कुरु ।। ७.७५.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā śarīro bālasya guptaḥ san śiṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।vipattiḥ paribhedo vā na bhavecca tathā kuru ।। 7.75.4 ॥

translations.english: Ensure that the body of the well-behaved child is protected so that no misfortune or injury may occur.
translations.hindi: प्रतिहता--निरुद्धा । ( गोऽ ) २ { रा० ) भागवं-भुगुयोत्रापत्यं च्यवनं | , भ्रंगुवंशी च्यवन उनके अशुआ हैं । वे तुमसे मिलने के लिए शीघ्रता कर रहे हैं और हमें तुम्हारे पास अपने आगमन की सूचना देने को भेजा हे

verses.sloka: एवमादिश्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् ।मनसा पुष्पकं दध्यावागच्छेति महायशाः ।। ७.७५.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamādiśya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṁ śubhalakṣaṇam ।manasā puṣpakaṁ dadhyāvāgaccheti mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.75.5 ॥

translations.english: Having thus instructed the auspicious-featured Lakshmana, the highly renowned Rama thought of the Pushpaka chariot in his mind, commanding it to come.

verses.sloka: इङ्गितं स तु विज्ञाय पुष्पको हेमभूषितः ।आजगाम मुहूर्तेन समीपे राघवस्य वै ।। ७.७५.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṅgitaṁ sa tu vijñāya puṣpako hemabhūṣitaḥ ।ājagāma muhūrtena samīpe rāghavasya vai ।। 7.75.6 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having understood Rama's mental signal, the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot arrived near Rama in a moment.
translations.hindi: तथा वे बहुत से फल मूल भी श्रीरघुनाथ जी की भेंट के लिए लाए थे । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने प्रसन्न हो, उनकी भेंट स्वीकार की

verses.sloka: सो ऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप ।वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किङ्करः समुपस्थितः ।। ७.७५.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'bravītpraṇato bhūtvā ayamasmi narādhipa ।vaśyastava mahābāho kiṅkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ ।। 7.75.7 ॥

translations.english: Having bowed, the Pushpaka spoke, "O king of men, O mighty-armed one, I am your obedient servant, present here."

verses.sloka: भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः ।अभिवाद्य महर्षींस्तान् विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। ७.७५.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhāṣitaṁ ruciraṁ śrutvā puṣpakasya narādhipaḥ ।abhivādya maharṣīṁstān vimānaṁ so 'dhyarohata ।। 7.75.8 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the pleasing words of Pushpaka, the king (Rama) saluted those great sages and then ascended the aerial chariot.
translations.hindi: जब वे सब राजसभा में गए, तत्र वे सब महात्मा तपस्वी, तीर्थो के जला से भरे हुए कलश हाथों में लिए हुए थे

verses.sloka: धनुर्गृहीत्वा तूणी च खड्गं च रुचिरप्रभम् ।निक्षिप्य नगरे वीरौ सौमित्रिभरतावुभौ ।। ७.७५.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhanurgṛhītvā tūṇī ca khaḍgaṁ ca ruciraprabham ।nikṣipya nagare vīrau saumitribharatāvubhau ।। 7.75.9 ॥

translations.english: Having taken his bow, quiver, and a beautifully shining sword, and having left both heroes Lakshmana and Bharata in the city, (Rama proceeded).

verses.sloka: प्रायात्प्रतीचीं हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः ।उत्तरामगमच्छ्रीमान्दिशं हिमवता वृताम् ।। ७.७५.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: prāyātpratīcīṁ haritaṁ vicinvaṁśca tatastataḥ ।uttarāmagamacchrīmāndiśaṁ himavatā vṛtām ।। 7.75.10 ॥

translations.english: The glorious Rama proceeded to the western direction, searching everywhere, and then went to the northern direction, which is covered by the Himalayas.
translations.hindi: समस्त तीर्था का जल और विविध प्रकार के कंदमूल फल ले कर, महाबाहु श्रीरामचन्द्र जी सब गुनियां से बोले

verses.sloka: अपश्यमानस्तत्रापि स्वल्पमप्यथ दुष्कृतम् ।पूर्वामपि दिशं सर्वामथो ऽपश्यन्नराधिपः ।। ७.७५.११ ॥

translations.english: Not finding even a slight evil deed there (in the north), the king then surveyed the entire eastern direction as well.
Seated in Pushpaka, the mighty-armed king then saw (the entire land) whose conduct was perfectly pure and as clear as the surface of a mirror.
translations.hindi: सुन्दर भूषत धोने की चोकियों के ऊपर बैठ गये । शत्रुहन्ता श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन सब ऋषियों के वेठ जाने पर, सिर झुका उनको प्रणाम किआ ओर हाथ जोड़ कर ये विनीतियुक्त बचन कहे

verses.sloka: दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः ।शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः ।। ७.७५.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāṁ diśamākrāmattato rājarṣinandanaḥ ।śaivalasyottare pārśve dadarśa sumahatsaraḥ ।। 7.75.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama, the son of the royal sage, proceeded towards the southern direction and on the northern side of Shaivala, he saw a very large lake.
translations.hindi: आप लोगों के पधारने का क्या कारण है! बतलाइए में आपका क्या हितकर काम करूं? आज्ञा दीजिए आपके सब मनोरथ पूरे होंगे

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्सरसि तप्यन्तं तापसं सुमहत्तपः ।ददर्श राघवः श्रीमाँल्लम्बमानमधोमुखम् ।। ७.७५.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasminsarasi tapyantaṁ tāpasaṁ sumahattapaḥ ।dadarśa rāghavaḥ śrīmām̐llambamānamadhomukham ।। 7.75.14 ॥

translations.english: In that lake, the glorious Rama saw an ascetic performing very great penance, hanging head downwards.
translations.hindi: में सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ. कि, यह सारा राज्य ओर _हृदयस्थित मेरे प्राण तक-ज्राह्मणों ही के लिए हैं

verses.sloka: राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम् ।उवाच स तदा वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत ।। ७.७५.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavastamupāgamya tapyantaṁ tapa uttamam ।uvāca sa tadā vākyaṁ dhanyastvamasi suvrata ।। 7.75.15 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."

verses.sloka: कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम ।कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिर्ह्यहम् ।। ७.७५.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyāṁ yonyāṁ tapovṛddha vartase dṛḍhavikrama ।kautūhalāttvāṁ pṛcchāmi rāmo dāśarathirhyaham ।। 7.75.16 ॥

translations.english: "O venerable ascetic, in which birth or species do you exist, O one of firm resolve? I ask you out of curiosity, for I am Rama, the son of Dasharatha."
translations.hindi: जो बड़े महात्मा थे; बड़े प्रपन्न हुए आर कहने लगे--हे त श्रेष्ठ ! इस भूमण्डल पर मुके तुमंको छोड़ ऐसे बचन अन्य ` कोई नही कह सकता आर यह वचन तुम्हारे कहने योग्य भी है

verses.sloka: को ऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभः परो ऽथवा ।वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यसि सुदुष्करम् ।यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस ।। ७.७५.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ko 'rtho manīṣitastubhyaṁ svargalābhaḥ paro 'thavā ।varāśrayo yadarthaṁ tvaṁ tapasyasi suduṣkaram ।yamāśritya tapastaptaṁ śrotumicchāmi tāpasa ।। 7.75.17 ॥

translations.english: "What is the purpose desired by you, is it the attainment of heaven or some other supreme boon, for which you are performing this very difficult penance, O ascetic? I wish to hear what you have resorted to for performing this penance."

verses.sloka: ब्राह्मणो वा ऽसि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वा ऽसि दुर्जयः ।वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो वा शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ।। ७.७५.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo vā 'si bhadraṁ te kṣatriyo vā 'si durjayaḥ ।vaiśyastṛtīyavarṇo vā śūdro vā satyavāgbhava ।। 7.75.18 ।।

translations.english: Rama asks the ascetic to truthfully state his varna, whether he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, a Vaishya, or a Shudra, wishing him well regardless.

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्तः स नराधिपेन ह्यवाक्छिरा दाशरथाय तस्मै ।उवाच जातिं नृपपुङ्गवाय यत्कारणे चैव तपःप्रयत्नः ।। ७.७५.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktaḥ sa narādhipena hyavākchirā dāśarathāya tasmai ।uvāca jātiṁ nṛpapuṅgavāya yatkāraṇe caiva tapaḥprayatnaḥ ।। 7.75.19 ।।

translations.english: Thus addressed by the king, the ascetic, with his head bowed, revealed his caste and the reason for his severe penance to Rama, the best of kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 75 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
